note: Failure-mode class per analyst, keyed on the id the corroboration joins use: a rollup finding's `tool` for the CVE feed, the scannerFindings category for every lane. Two analysts in one class read the same kind of input by the same kind of method, so they can be wrong together; their agreement is `same-basis`, never `corroborated`. An analyst missing here is `unclassified` and never counts as an independent basis. Classes are a closed vocabulary; a detector naming an undeclared class fails the load.

classes.advisory-lookup: a resolved dependency set (lockfile or installed tree) matched against an advisory database
classes.declared-dependency-lookup: dependencies as declared in build files and version catalogs, resolved through deps.dev, matched against an advisory database
classes.library-fingerprint: vendored library files identified by content fingerprint and matched against the tool's own vulnerability list
classes.reachability-analysis: an advisory match qualified by static call-path analysis over first-party code
classes.package-behaviour: package content and registry metadata judged against heuristics for malicious behaviour
classes.regex-pattern: source or history matched against regular-expression credential patterns
classes.pattern-rule: first-party source matched against syntactic or AST rules without inter-procedural flow
classes.dataflow: first-party source analysed by inter-procedural data flow or a code property graph
classes.api-metadata: the hosting platform's configuration read through its API
